soilProfiles.recommendation: Apply 10 tonnes/hectare well-rotted FYM and biofertilizers (Azospirillum / PSB) for sugarcane tillering.
Incorporate green manure (Sunnhemp) to improve water infiltration in heavy black soils.
Apply Zinc Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha and Rhizobium seed treatment for Pigeon Pea (Tur Dal).
Apply agricultural lime @ 500 kg/ha once in 3 years for arecanut root rhizosphere conditioning.

pestDiagnostics.symptoms: Olive-green to black velvety spots on young leaves and developing fruit surfaces.
pestDiagnostics.naturalRemedy: Spray Cow Urine + Neem leaf extract (Neemastra) or Sour Buttermilk spray (5%). Prune infected twig canopies.
pestDiagnostics.chemicalAlternative: Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 30ml/100L water at petal fall.

pestDiagnostics.symptoms: Concentric target-like brown spots on foliage, pin-holes on fruit near calyx.
pestDiagnostics.naturalRemedy: Install yellow sticky traps + Pheromone traps @ 5/bigha. Spray Agniastra @ 3L in 100L water.

pestDiagnostics.symptoms: Ragged feeding holes on leaf whorls with sawdust-like frass.
pestDiagnostics.naturalRemedy: Apply sand + wood ash in central whorls. Release Trichogramma parasitoids.

soil_data.recommendation: Balanced NPK application with organic compost / Jeevamrit.
Apply Farmyard Manure (FYM) @ 25 t/ha. Apply balanced NPK (250:100:125 kg/ha) for Sugarcane Co 86032.
Maintain deep tillage; apply Rhizobium seed treatment for Soyabean and balanced zinc sulphate.
Apply Trichoderma viride @ 5 kg/ha for wilt control in Red Gram (Tur Dal). Incorporate gypsum.
Apply Agricultural Lime / Dolomite @ 300 kg/ha once every two years for Arecanut and Paddy terraces.
Drip fertigation with potassium sulphate (0-0-50) during grape berry elongation and veraison.

agronomy_data.irrigation_practices: Sub-surface drip fertigation @ 60% CPE; skip-furrow method during summer
agronomy_data.fertilizer_recommendation: UAS Bangalore package: 250kg N : 100kg P2O5 : 125kg K2O per hectare
agronomy_data.intercropping: Soybean or French bean as 60-day intercrop

agronomy_data.irrigation_practices: Protective irrigation at tillering and grain filling stages
agronomy_data.fertilizer_recommendation: 50kg N : 40kg P2O5 : 25kg K2O + Azospirillum seed biofertilizer
agronomy_data.intercropping: Field bean (Avare) or Red Gram in 4:1 or 8:2 ratio

agronomy_data.irrigation_practices: Rainfed; single protective sprinkler irrigation at pod initiation if dry spell occurs
agronomy_data.fertilizer_recommendation: 25kg N : 50kg P2O5 / ha + Rhizobium and PSB culture seed treatment

agronomy_data.irrigation_practices: Drip irrigation @ 16-20 litres/palm/day during non-monsoon months
agronomy_data.fertilizer_recommendation: 100g N : 40g P2O5 : 140g K2O per palm/year in split doses with green manure
agronomy_data.intercropping: Black pepper on trunk standards, banana, cocoa

agronomy_data.irrigation_practices: Sprinkler irrigation at flowering and pod filling stages
agronomy_data.intercropping: French beans, peas or white clover

pest_data.symptoms: Dead hearts in young shoots aged 1 to 3 months; pinholes at base
pest_data.biological_control: Release Trichogramma chilonis egg parasitoid @ 50,000/ha at 10-day intervals
pest_data.chemical_control: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.4 ml/L drenching at cane root zone

pest_data.symptoms: Bored holes on pods with caterpillar head feeding inside; dropped flowers
pest_data.etl_threshold: 1 larva per meter row length or 10% damaged pods
pest_data.biological_control: Install pheromone traps @ 10/ha; spray HaNPV 250 LE/ha with 0.5% jaggery
pest_data.chemical_control: Emamectin benzoate 5% SG @ 4g/10L of water during 50% flowering

pest_data.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on tender nuts followed by heavy nut dropping; rotting calyx
pest_data.etl_threshold: Appearance of initial water-soaked spots during heavy monsoon rains
pest_data.biological_control: Cover bunches with polythene covers (shred-proof) before pre-monsoon rains
pest_data.chemical_control: Prophylactic spray of 1% Bordeaux mixture with resin adhesive before monsoon onset

pest_data.symptoms: Shot holes on whorl leaves; copious sawdust-like frass inside central whorl
pest_data.biological_control: Apply sand + neem cake (9:1 ratio) in plant whorl at 20 days after germination
pest_data.chemical_control: Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 0.5 ml/L targeted directly into the whorl

pest_data.symptoms: Circular greyish scales encrusting bark and premature leaf chlorosis.
pest_data.control_measures: Spray Neemastra / fermented buttermilk (5%) or contact bio-fungicide.
pest_data.naturalRemedy: Spray Neemastra / fermented buttermilk (5%) or contact bio-fungicide.

schemes.name: Karnataka Raitha Siri Scheme (ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ರೈತ ಸಿರಿ ಯೋಜನೆ)
schemes.department: Directorate of Agriculture, Govt of Karnataka
schemes.disbursementType: DBT Direct Bank Transfer (Direct Bank Credit via Parihara/e-Kalyana)
schemes.description: Direct financial assistance of ₹10,000/ha for promotion of minor millets, sugarcane, and pulses linked to Bhoomi RTC.
schemes.eligibility: All small & marginal farmers in Karnataka with Bhoomi RTC verified parcels.
requiredDocs: Active Bank Account with NPCI Aadhaar Seeding

schemes.name: Karnataka Krishi Bhagya Scheme (ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಕೃಷಿ ಭಾಗ್ಯ ಯೋಜನೆ)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture & Water Shed Development, Karnataka
schemes.disbursementType: Package Subsidy (Farm Pond Krishi Honda, Tarpaulin, Micro-Drip & Pump)
schemes.description: Comprehensive dryland farming package helping farmers construct farm ponds (ಕೃಷಿ ಹೊಂಡ) with 80-90% subsidy.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers in dryland agro-climatic zones across Karnataka.

schemes.name: Karnataka Ganga Kalyana Scheme (ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಗಂಗಾ ಕಲ್ಯಾಣ ಯೋಜನೆ - Solar Borewell)
schemes.department: Minor Irrigation & Social Welfare Dept, Govt of Karnataka
schemes.description: Drilling of irrigation borewells and supply of solar submersible pump sets with micro-irrigation lines.
schemes.eligibility: Small & marginal farmers owning at least 1.5 to 5 acres of dryland.
